equity.level_reason: Age and sex are described only as similar across periods, and U.S. residency is a traveler descriptor not framed as a social position. No disparity is reported.

level_alternative.reason: U.S. residency differs between periods and could be read as a nativity or migration-status descriptor, which would make the level 1.

equity.equity_measurement: Demographics are reported only as similar across periods (supplement); U.S. residency is the one difference noted and is not analysed further.

notes: The design is a before/after comparison of pooled surveillance results with adjusted mixed-effects logistic regression, using the voluntary period as the referent. Incidence normalization (division by the period maximum, times 100) is arithmetic, so it is not a procedure. Pooling and volunteer participation are acknowledged as limitations.
view_issues: Text gives the 4-week sensitivity aOR 0.65 (95% CI 0.44–0.96) with 'p<0.001', but that CI implies p of about 0.03. Pool size ≥15 shifts from unadjusted OR 1.4 to adjusted OR 2.6 without comment.
